notes.title: Digitizer my new game will release on 8 April 2022
notes.notes:
My new game Digitizer is about to release on 8 April 2022.
Check out the Steam store page:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/1262760/Digitizer/

Digitizer is a Sci-Fi FPS RPG. It’s a story-driven open-world game with multiple factions. 
Fight, craft, drive and make your story choices that will bring the conflict to its end.

The year is 2127. You play the role of a resistance member's son who was destined to lead the war against a high-tech city council and its new technology. 
Will you fulfill your destiny? Or will you support the city council and lead the world into a new future? 
The choice is yours.
